caption: Eusebiuskerk, Arnhem
composition: Gothic brick tower with a 1964 crown and empty glass balconies · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Eusebiuskerk rises from Kerkplein, a Gothic brick tower built into the church, finished with the octagonal crown of 1964 and a low tent roof. Two glass balconies hang on cables and are empty because the church is closed. The sky is clear, about 13.7°C, with wind near 5.8 km/h, and a bright moon is up. The John Frost Bridge and Sonsbeek are not in this frame.
